_about: Prices on this site that come from public USDA AMS Market News reports. Updated weekly by .github/workflows/update-prices.yml (tools/update_prices.py). Edit by hand only if you also run `python3 tools/update_prices.py apply`.

bred_cow.label: Bred cow purchase price
bred_cow.report_name: Cattlemen's Livestock, Dalhart TX weekly auction
bred_cow.rule: BRED COWS, Medium & Large 1 (not 1-2), 2-4 yr, 2nd trimester; head-weighted average of matching lines
bred_cow.detail_html: Cattlemen's Livestock, Dalhart TX (ams_1953.pdf) — "BRED COWS, Medium & Large 1" line, 17 hd, 1,243–1,327 lb, $2,800–$2,850/hd

fed_cattle.label: Fed/finished cattle sale price
fed_cattle.report_name: 5 Area Weekly Weighted Average Direct Slaughter Cattle (LM_CT150)
fed_cattle.rule: Live FOB steers, Over 80% Choice, weighted average
fed_cattle.detail_html: USDA AMS "5 Area Weekly Weighted Average Direct Slaughter Cattle" (ams_2477.pdf) — live FOB steers, Over 80% Choice, $218–$223/cwt, weighted avg, 1,606 lb, 19,383 hd

bred_heifer.label: Bred heifer sale price
bred_heifer.rule: BRED HEIFERS, Medium & Large 1 (not 1-2), any age/stage; head-weighted average of matching lines
bred_heifer.detail_html: USDA AMS "Texas Weekly Cattle Auction Summary" (ams_1955.pdf) — "BRED HEIFERS, Medium & Large 1" (3 lines, head-weighted average): 58 hd, 812–1,330 lb, $2,600–$3,700/hd, average $3,465.01/hd

steer.label: Steer price, 516.4 lb reference
steer.rule: FEEDER STEERS, Medium & Large 1, 500-549 lb, plain lots; head-weighted average of matching lines
steer.detail_html: USDA AMS "Texas Weekly Cattle Auction Summary" (ams_1955.pdf) — "FEEDER STEERS, Medium & Large 1, 500–549 lb", plain lots only (1 line): 144 hd, 500–549 lb, $360.00–$450.00/cwt, average $407.31/cwt

heifer.label: Heifer price, 531.3 lb reference

heifer.detail_html: USDA AMS "Texas Weekly Cattle Auction Summary" (ams_1955.pdf) — "FEEDER HEIFERS, Medium & Large 1, 500–549 lb", plain lots only (1 line): 131 hd, 500–545 lb, $333.00–$395.00/cwt, average $379.18/cwt

stocker_700.label: Stocker sale price, 700 lb path
stocker_700.rule: FEEDER STEERS, Medium & Large 1, 700-749 lb, plain lots; head-weighted average of matching lines
stocker_700.detail_html: USDA AMS "Texas Weekly Cattle Auction Summary" (ams_1955.pdf) — "FEEDER STEERS, Medium & Large 1, 700–749 lb", plain lots only (1 line): 23 hd, 700–740 lb, $320.00–$365.00/cwt, average $334.67/cwt

stocker_800.label: Stocker sale price, 800 lb path
stocker_800.rule: FEEDER STEERS, Medium & Large 1, 800-849 lb, plain lots; head-weighted average of matching lines
stocker_800.detail_html: USDA AMS "Texas Weekly Cattle Auction Summary" (ams_1955.pdf) had no plain "FEEDER STEERS, Medium & Large 1, 800–849 lb" line on Oct 30, 2026. Set to the 700–749 lb price that week ($334.67/cwt) times the steer weight curve's 800 lb ÷ 700 lb ratio (0.975). The weekly job replaces it with the first real 800–849 lb line.
